local_address.description: Local IP address to bind the DNS server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

local_port.description: UDP/TCP port to listen on for DNS queries.

api.description: Enable the PowerDNS API (query console) on port 8081.

api_key.description: Secret key used to authenticate API requests (required if API is enabled).

recursor.description: IP address of an upstream recursive resolver to forward non-authoritative queries to (optional).

max_qps.description: Maximum queries per second allowed before throttling starts.

query_local_address_timeout.description: Timeout (in ms) for queries to local addresses (e.g., when resolving internal names).

threads.description: Number of worker threads to spawn (set to CPU core count for best performance).

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logging (0 = minimal, 9 = extremely verbose).

log_dns_queries.description: Log every incoming DNS query to syslog.

dnssec.description: DNSSEC validation behavior. 'process' actively validates; 'log-*' only logs results.

backends.description: List of backend modules to load. Common options: gsqlite3 (SQLite), mysql, postgresql. Multiple backends can be listed, separated by commas.

gsqlite3_database.description: Path to SQLite database file when using gsqlite3 backend.

gsqlite3_dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC support in SQLite backend (requires schema >= v4).

gsqlite3_pragma_synchronous.description: SQLite synchronous pragma: 'FULL' safest for durability, 'NORMAL' better performance.

gmysql_user.description: MySQL username with access to the PowerDNS database.

gmysql_password.description: Password for the MySQL user (empty = prompt or use socket auth).

gmysql_dbname.description: Name of the MySQL database to use for PowerDNS data.

gpostgresql_user.description: PostgreSQL username with access to the PowerDNS database.

query_local_address.description: Source IP addresses for sending queries (comma/space-separated).
